palette: Molten amber and corten steel-orange against deep slate-grey, with electric cobalt accent from reactor coolant — Pittsburgh's industrial palette re-read as compute infrastructure
lighting: Late afternoon overcast with a faint golden thermal haze from cooling towers — light diffusing through water vapor, casting diffuse shadows on corrugated metal and concrete fins
instagram_prompts: First-person perspective (FPP) optic sensor capture from ground level. The view from the base of an enormous high-voltage transformer yard at dusk, Pittsburgh river valley visible in the blurred distance. Corrugated steel substations, chains of insulators, buzzing high-voltage lines overhead. The ground is wet tarmac with puddles reflecting orange transformer housings. Molten amber light, industrial haze. Scale is impossibly large — each transformer is a skyscraper from this vantage. Deep slate-grey sky, electric cobalt glow from power distribution panels. No text, no overlays.
